Black Friday 2026 is upon us. With the official event date set for Friday, November 27, many of the deals at all the biggest retailers are already live, with savings galore to be found on a raft of PC hardware and technology.

Here at our live coverage, you'll find the best deals in every category, curated by our experts who are working around the clock. We're hitting CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSDs, gaming laptops, desktop PCs, peripherals, monitors, and more. Our buying advice is built on our years of testing experience, as well as extensive price tracking tools, our benchmarking data, and hands-on reviews.

With the PC component market facing pressures like never before, finding a good deal and making informed choices is more important than ever, so let us do the legwork and help you get the best deal, whether you're looking to buy, build, or upgrade.

November 25, 2026 – 2:11 AM Good morning and welcome to the beginning of our Black Friday 2026 coverage. Here you'll find round-the-clock coverage of all the latest and greatest Black Friday deals at all your favorite PC hardware retailers!

November 25, 2026 – 2:11 AM It's Stephen to start you off this morning, bringing you a host of deals from the US and the UK!

November 25, 2026 – 2:20 AM Score a UK SSD for its lowest-ever price

If you're on the hunt for an excellent SSD in the UK, there's a big old saving to be had on this Sandisk Optimus GX Pro 8100 1TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD. A rebranded version of the old Western Digital SN8100, this drive scored brilliantly in our testing earlier this year.

Right now, you can score one for £175.99 instead of £268.99, a 35% saving and the lowest-ever price recorded on this drive at Amazon UK.

Optimus GX PRO 8100 1TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD, M.2 2280: was £268.99 now £175.99
Get a 1TB PCIe 5.0 SSD with 14,900 MB/s read speeds and 11,000 MB/s write speeds. With DDR4 RAM and a Silicon Motion SM2508 controller. View Deal

Our testing involved the 8TB version of this drive, with boasts better write speeds than the 1TB version, but you can see from our benchmark data how it stacks up to rivals in latency.

Tom's Hardware Tom's Hardware Tom's Hardware If you're in the market for more capacity, this listing also includes savings on the 2TB and 4TB models, however the 1TB version boasts the biggest saving and the best value overall, in my opinion. - Stephen Warwick

November 25, 2026 – 2:36 AM 4TB SSD for just $0.10 per GB

One of the best SSD deals we've seen in the US so far is this excellent Team Group T-Force G50 Evo. This Gen 4 M.2 2280 drive is one of the cheapest 4TB drives out there right now at $0.10 cents per GB. With AI inflating the cost of storage and RAM, this is as good as it gets for a high capacity drive these days. Save $86 on the list price bringing the cost to just $399.

T-Force G50 Evo M.2 2280 4TB PCIe 4.0 x4: was $485.99 now $399.99
This T-Force G50 Evo offers sequential read speeds of 5,000 MB/s and write speeds of up to 4,800 MB/s. View Deal

An entry-level drive, this PCIe 4.0 model offers sequential read speeds of up to 5,000 MB/s and sequential write speeds of up to 4,700 MB/s. It also features SLC Caching and Host Memory Buffer. While this certainly isn't the fastest drive on the market, it is more than enough for an all-around drive for storing games and files, if not for higher-octane use cases like video editing, or anything else latency-intensive. - Stephen Warwick

November 25, 2026 – 2:50 AM Record low price on the king of gaming CPUs

The legendary Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU may not be the out-and-out fastest gaming CPU on the market anymore, but it is still the best thanks to its devastating gaming performance and its much lower power draw versus the 9850X3D. It just hit a new lowest-ever price at Amazon UK, now just £312.99. This is perfect for anyone on AM5 looking for an upgrade, or anyone who wants to build a storming gaming PC in the Black Friday sales. That's a lot cheaper than it was in the June sales, when we saw it at £339.99.

Ryzen 7 9800X3D: was £372 now £339.99
This 8-core X3D beast of a processor is on sale at its lowest ever price right now. While the AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D is faster by around 3%, benchmark data compiled by the Tom's Hardware team confirms how close of a run it is, with this CPU requiring 30% more electrical power for almost the same performance. View Deal

As you can see from our testing data, this is an unbelievable CPU for gaming. It powers high frame rates thanks to its industry-leading 3D cache, which means the CPU has to fall back on your RAM much less often, drastically boosting frame rates.

Tom's Hardware Tom's Hardware Tom's Hardware This is a CPU that needs no introduction and leads the pack even at its list price. At £312.99, I'm seriously considering buying one myself. - Stephen Warwick

November 25, 2026 – 3:09 AM Dell's MacBook Neo rival hits all time low — $549 for the XPS 13

(Image credit: Tom's Hardware) If you want a Windows alternative to the MacBook Neo at a price that won't break the bank, this Dell XPS 13 with Intel Core 5 CPU is now just $549.99.

The Dell XPS 13 with an Intel Core 5 320, 8GB of RAM, and 256 GB of storage. View Deal

This model comes with Intel's Wildcat Lake Core 5 320 CPU, 8GB of RAM, and a 256GB SSD, matching the Neo in terms of specs. You also get a backlit keyboard, which you won't find on the MacBook, as well as a higher-resolution 2560 x 1600 touch screen. As our testing shows, the Dell can't beat the Mac for outright performance, but it does run Windows and is $100 cheaper at the current prices.

(Image credit: Tom's Hardware) If you'd rather have the Neo, the cheapest price is currently $649 at Amazon, a $50 saving on the list price, which Apple increased not long after launch.

Apple's base MacBook Neo has an A18 Pro chip, 256GB of storage, and 8GB of RAM. A solid alternative with a more powerful SoC. View Deal

Either of these will serve you well if you want a lightweight, portable computer for basic tasks like word processing, checking your emails, and on-the-go college assignments. However, they won't cut the mustard if you're looking for something to game on, edit videos, or do anything else graphic intensive. - Stephen Warwick

November 25, 2026 – 3:26 AM Get a touchscreen LCD for your rig — Corsair Xeneon Edge just £175 or $199.

The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a nifty 14.5-inch 2K portable LCD touchscreen for your PC. You can use it in a number of different ways: embedded in a compatible Corsair case, mounted on your setup with magnets, or just sat on your desk as a standalone monitor. It can be used to keep an eye on your PC's vital signs, as a media control unit for apps like Spotify, or as a streaming extension for monitoring chat or as a virtual Stream Deck. Now at its lowest-ever price in the UK, it's just £174.99. You can also score it in the US for $199 instead of $249.99, a $50 saving.

The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a 14.5-inch display designed to serve as an extension for your desktop and give you a small screen to host your most important apps. Its versatility means you can mount it practically anywhere — horizontally under your main monitor, vertically beside your primary display, or as a digital status panel inside your PC case. View Deal

Xeneon Edge: was £219.99 now £174.99
This same display is discounted at Amazon UK in two colors, and is the lowest-ever price we've seen on this model. Get the same 2560 x 720 p display with an LCD touchscreen. View Deal

With its 60 Hz refresh rate and multi-touch, the Xeneon Edge is one of the most popular PC accessories going right now, and makes for a really novel and unique upgrade to your space. It also comes with 14 magnets so you can attach it at will to any metal surface. There are tons of built-in widgets available through Corsair's marketplace, including many free options such as NVA live scores or a Steam deal tracker. You can even 3D print your own accessories to customize it. - Stephen Warwick
